**ARE YOU READY TO DRIVE GANNI’S WHOLESALE GROWTH ACROSS SCANDINAVIA WITH PURPOSE AND PASSION?

**GANNI is looking for a Wholesale Area Manager to join our global Wholesale team!

In this role, you will play a key part — together with your fellow Area Managers — in elevating GANNI’s brand presence across the Nordics market by nurturing strategic wholesale relationships and ensuring strong commercial performance.

The area manager will take over the whole Scandinavian market to contribute to regional growth and brand elevation in close collaboration with the broader EMEA Wholesale team.

This is a dynamic mid-level role that blends commercial execution, market insight, and operational excellence — and we’re looking for someone ready to contribute and grow within an ambitious team environment.

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Wholesale Area Manager, you will support and manage wholesale partnerships across the Nordics region, working closely with other Area Managers, the Head of WS EMEA and the Executive Wholesale & Franchises Director.

Your role will focus on driving sales performance, strengthening category growth, and ensuring seamless alignment between GANNI and our wholesale partners — all in line with our global wholesale strategy.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**

• Develop and execute a comprehensive business plan aligned with the brand strategy to drive growth and strengthen GANNI’s presence across the Nordics.

• Participate in prospecting and onboarding of new wholesale partners across the Nordics.

• Strategically collaborate with wholesale partners to meet weekly, monthly, and annual trade expectations.

• Monitor sell-in and sell-out performance, taking proactive measures to maximize sell-through, reorder rates, and profitability.

• Ensure all partners and activations are aligned with GANNI brand guidelines and deliver a consistent brand experience.

• Collaborate with marketing, VM, and merchandising teams to deliver local marketing initiatives, activations, and sales-driving campaigns.

• Provide exemplary day-to-day support to our wholesale partners as their main point of contact with GANNI HQ.

• Support showroom operations in Paris, including OTB discussions/negotiations and collection feedback.

• Stay up to date on the Nordics market trends, competitors, and opportunities and actively share insights internally.

• Coordinate with logistics and internal teams to ensure timely delivery and payment follow-up.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a commercially driven and collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced and international environment.

• 5-7 years of experience in international wholesale within fashion/apparel.

• Strong understanding of the Nordics market dynamics, consumer behavior, and wholesale operations.

• Solid understanding of retail math, including sell-through, mark-up, and OTB planning.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear actions.

• Experience building and maintaining client relationships.

• Experience supporting seasonal sales campaigns and showroom environments.

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with wholesale systems such as JOOR is a plus.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

• Comfortable working across different markets and cultures within the Nordics.

• Flexibility to travel within the region as required.

• Fluent in Danish and English; additional Scandinavian languages are an advantage.

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing Wholesale team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**You will be based at our Copenhagen HQ, while maintaining close and continuous contact with the Paris office and ensuring strong collaboration and alignment with the Denmark team.

We welcome applications from all people regardless of gender identities, sexual orientations, ethnicities, racial identities, religious beliefs, disability statuses and personal expressions. We only want to know why you’re great for this role, so please avoid including your picture, age, and marital status in your CV.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

Opportunity

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We are now looking for our new Regional Head Europe- People Operations to join our Global Operations Team (GOT) - People Advisory Services

As a Regional Head Europe- People Operations, you will hold regional responsibility for delivering professional, high-quality and integrated HR support across diverse employee groups and cultures. You will lead the regional People Advisory Services team, strengthen employee experience, translate the global HR service delivery model into effective regional execution, and drive continuous improvement through strong stakeholder partnership, disciplined service management and capability building.

What We Offer

We offer you an exciting global career at the forefront of world trade. And thanks to our global scale, you will be well-positioned to explore opportunities at Maersk around the world. The many other highlights include the most modern talent development initiatives and competitive benefits. We are proud of our people who define our company’s industry leadership, global team culture and customer-centric focus every day.

Key Responsibilities

• Consistently drive and deliver high-quality, integrated HR services across the region to strengthen employee experience.

• Provide leadership to the regional People Advisory Services team, creating an environment where colleagues are engaged, proud of their work and connected to a clear sense of purpose.

• Ensure implementation and ongoing effectiveness of the regional People Advisory Services structure in line with agreed timelines and resource plans.

• Translate the global HR service delivery model into a regional, brand-agnostic implementation and resource plan.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Senior Medical Director to be a part of our Global Clinical Development Team.

The Medical Director will be accountable for the medical oversight of one or more clinical trials, medical review and communication of data, and medical input into regulatory documents and presentations.

**Responsibilities

**

• Lead the development of the program strategy for assigned trials/compounds and participate in the development of the clinical development plan (CDP)

• Lead creation and review of clinical components of key documents, clinical and regulatory documents, annual safety updates, and registration dossiers (ie, protocol, ICF, IB, annual safety updates, study reports, regulatory submissions [Briefing documents, IND, Clinical dossiers] supporting registration, market access, and commercialization of the compound(s)

• Oversee early stage programs and develop clinical programs including component studies

• Oversee safety of the drug, including the safety aspects of patients in clinical studies and signal detection with support of the Safety physician

• Create, integrate, and execute overall medical strategy of assigned clinical development programs; provide strategic medical advice on potential new projects (internal & external)

• Contribute to publication and clinical communication strategy in coordination with Scientific Communications; provide inputs to key external presentations

• Provide strategic input and development support for clinical plans and individual trial protocols

• Interact with key opinion leaders to ensure implementation of the latest clinical and medical thinking and guidelines into clinical development plans, as well as consideration of novel medical methods development and new po

• Contribute to medical department best practices, standardization and to cross-functional process improvements

• Support the development of case report forms, perform medical monitoring, liaise with investigators and site personnel, perform preliminary and exploratory data analyses on clinical trials, author clinical study reports, provide input on publication materials, and participate in advisory boards.

• Contribute to publication and clinical communication strategy in coordination with Scientific Communications; provide inputs to key external presentations

• Support the development of other relevant documents that are necessary for the advancement of the product pipeline

• Serve as medical and technical resource for clinical issues raised by internal and external collaborators, investigators, consultants and contractors

• Create medical deliverables: clinical development plans, concept sheets, briefing books, and label and marketing application dossier

• Contribute to medical input to preclinical development of candidate therapeutic antibodies

• Drive and monitor quality of all clinical documents (e.g., Investigators’ Brochures, protocols, study reports, clinical components of regulatory submissions, safety documents) produced by CDT

• Interact with key opinion leaders to ensure implementation of the latest clinical and medical thinking and guidelines into clinical development plans, as well as consideration of novel medical methods development and new potential targets.

• Participate in multi-function teams necessary for the advancement of the product pipeline

• Attend relevant congresses or other relevant fora to maintain up-to-date scientific/medical knowledge

**Requirements

**

• MD background with a minimum of 3+ years of directly related industry experience within oncology or hematology

• Significant experience with relevant areas of oncology

• Proven ability to build and lead teams and inspire trust among colleagues

• Experience representing team and organization in a variety of internal/external settings

• Experience training and managing team members

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK1.041.600,00---1.562.400,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

**Working at Ørsted

**In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

General information and how to apply

• 
You will be reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer.

• 
The position is full time.

• 
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the selected candidate will start as soon as possible.

• 
Application takes place via the application system here at LinkedIn.

Note that the application system only allows uploading of a single document.

•

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facility Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Advansor is a part of Dover Corporation – please apply on Dover’s website:

Sustainable CO2 climate solutions

_Are you passionate about financial planning and analytics? Do you want to shape financial performance insights and facilitate strategic decision‑making for the world’s largest jewellery brand? … If so, then we have an exciting opportunity for you!

_**Help shape the financial future of one of the world’s most iconic brands!

**The Group FP&A function has ownership of managing and steering the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting towards CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As our new Senior FP&A Manager, you will lead Pandora’s long‑term planning process and provide the analysis our executive team relies on to make informed decisions. You will translate strategic priorities into clear financial insights, build a strong understanding of our value drivers, and help ensure that the company is set up for long‑term success. To succeed, you must bring a strong financial background, excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to collaborate effectively across a wide, global stakeholder landscape.

This role requires deep expertise in financial planning, reporting, and modelling, along with solid knowledge of cash flow and balance sheet mechanics. You should be able to manage multiple priorities independently and perform effectively in a fast‑paced, constantly evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead the long‑term financial planning process across the PANDORA Group, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and supporting the translation of strategic priorities into financial outcomes

• Conduct and interpret detailed financial analyses to help the organization understand deviations from long‑term plan.

• Develop robust financial models to simulate business scenarios, assess risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making

• Act as a strategic finance partner, helping shape financial targets and performance expectations across a wide range of stakeholder groups

• Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and reports for executive leadership meetings, distilling complex financial information into clear, actionable insights

• Drive long‑term cash flow and balance sheet forecasting, ensuring alignment with overall financial plans and supporting capital allocation decisions

• Independently manage ad hoc strategic and financial analyses for senior stakeholders up to the CFO level, ensuring timely and accurate responses to critical business questions

**Required Skills

**

• Strong ability to understand complex ideas and simplify them

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under tight deadlines

• Ability to build high‑level financial models and scenarios

• Advanced Excel and solid financial modelling skills

• Experience with planning/reporting systems

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

**Required Experience

**

• 5-8+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or finance transformation

• Experience working in a global or regional role

• Strong background in financial modelling, reporting, and scenario analysis

• Experience driving cross‑functional projects and process improvements

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Our lean hiring process

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (15 min) ONSITE

**World leader in allergy

**ALK is a global specialty pharmaceutical company based in Denmark, dedicated to allergy treatment and innovation for over a century. Present in 46 markets with production sites in the USA, Spain, France, and Denmark, we reach 3.1 million patients annually and aim to help 5 million people living with allergies by 2030.

Our 2,800 employees support this mission, with Global IT enabling modern technologies and world-class support across the organization.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Document your work in ServiceNow and escalate complex or recurring issues to the right team

**What You Bring

**What We Offer

**Become a part of ALK

**ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. jobs.description:
Manager, Skilled Workers – Packaging & Filling Line Maintenance

Location: Måløv, Denmark

Are you an experienced leader with a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and a passion for developing skilled technical employees?

Do you thrive in an operational environment where people leadership, equipment reliability and continuous improvement are equally important?

Are you ready to take responsibility for a skilled maintenance team and help strengthen operational performance within HRT Packaging?

If so, we would like to hear from you.

The Position

As Manager, Skilled Workers within HRT Packaging, you will lead a team of skilled maintenance employees responsible for supporting the reliability and performance of packaging and filling equipment at our Måløv site.

This is an operational leadership position requiring someone who understands the realities of a production environment and has already demonstrated the ability to lead technical employees.

You will have the opportunity to shape how the team operates, develop the capabilities of experienced technical employees and contribute directly to the department's operational performance.

Working closely with Production and other technical functions, you will balance immediate operational requirements with longer term maintenance improvements, ensuring your team has the direction, structure and support needed to succeed.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

• Leading, coaching and developing skilled maintenance employees, establishing clear expectations, accountability and continuous development.

• Managing daily maintenance priorities, resources and team performance to support reliable production.

• Ensuring effective preventive and corrective maintenance to improve equipment reliability and minimise downtime.

• Using maintenance data, KPIs and performance trends to identify opportunities and make informed operational decisions.

• Supporting structured problem-solving and addressing recurring equipment issues.

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen equipment reliability and operational efficiency.

• Building effective working relationships with Production, Quality, Engineering and other relevant stakeholders.

• Ensuring maintenance activities comply with GMP, safety and quality requirements.Creating a positive, collaborative and performance focused team culture.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced operational leader who understands both the technical and people-related challenges of managing skilled employees within a manufacturing environment.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

• Proven experience leading skilled technical employees within a manufacturing environment, including responsibility for team performance, employee development and day-to-day operational delivery.

• Demonstrable experience managing or formally supervising employees within maintenance, engineering, production or a comparable technical function.

• Practical experience coaching employees, addressing performance challenges and handling difficult leadership situations.

• A sound understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment reliability and manufacturing operations.

• Experience using operational data or performance indicators to support decisions and drive improvements.

• Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.

• A structured approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP regulated operations, packaging equipment or filling processes would be advantageous.

• We also welcome applications from experienced supervisors and team leaders who have already demonstrated meaningful people leadership and are ready to take on broader management responsibility.

• About YouYou are a confident, visible and approachable leader who enjoys working closely with skilled technical employees.

• You understand that effective leadership requires more than technical knowledge. You can set clear expectations, address performance challenges, coach employees and create an environment where people take ownership of their work.

• You are comfortable making decisions in a busy production environment, using data and operational insights to establish priorities.

• You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can constructively challenge stakeholders when necessary.

• Above all, you bring the maturity, accountability and practical leadership experience needed to develop a team while maintaining operational performance.

About The Department

You will join HRT Packaging at our Måløv site, part of Novo's manufacturing organisation.

The department is responsible for packaging hormone replacement therapy products, contributing to the delivery of medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients.

Our maintenance teams play an essential role in ensuring that production equipment operates safely, efficiently and reliably.

With increasing production demands, we are continuing to strengthen our maintenance capabilities, equipment performance and ways of working.

As Manager, Skilled Workers, you will have the opportunity to influence how the team develops and contributes to the department's future success.

Why Novo

At Novo, your skills, dedication and ambition help us change lives for the better.

In return, we offer an opportunity to work alongside talented colleagues, take on meaningful responsibilities and continue developing professionally and personally.

Working at NovoAt Novo,

we don't wait for change. We drive it.

We're a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future.

We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them.

From research and development to manufacturing, marketing and sales, we're all working to move the needle on patient care.

Salary And Benefits

The salary range for this position is DKK 651,000 to 956,900 annually.

The final salary will depend on the candidate's qualifications, experience and applicable employment conditions.

Incentives And Benefits

At Novo, we offer a competitive remuneration package and a range of benefits designed to support our employees' professional and personal wellbeing.

Applicable benefits and incentive arrangements will be discussed as part of the recruitment process.

What We Offer

There is nothing ordinary about working at Novo.

Our purpose is to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases, building upon our heritage in diabetes.

We do so by pioneering scientific breakthroughs, expanding access to our medicines and working to prevent and ultimately cure disease.

We offer an inclusive and collaborative working environment where employees can develop their capabilities, contribute their ideas and make a meaningful difference.

Inclusive Recruitment

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to be the best company for the world, and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures.

We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and the communities in which we operate.

Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Student Assistant, People & Culture Operations

The position is expected to be 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

**Employee Lifecycle and Data Management

**

• Maintain and update employee data in our HRIS, SuccessFactors, and support high data quality

• Support the preparation of employment documentation and administrative employee changes

• Coordinate and support employee onboarding and offboarding activities

• Assist with administration related to holidays, leave and other employee lifecycle processes

• Prepare reports, data extracts and other operational material

**

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we do not expect you to know everything before joining us. We imagine that you:

• Are currently studying and are interested in gaining practical experience within People & Culture. Studies within HR, Business Administration, Economics or a related area would be an advantage, but are not a requirement

• Are structured and comfortable keeping track of several tasks and deadlines

• Have strong attention to detail and enjoy working with data

• Are comfortable using Microsoft Office, and curious about learning HR systems and other digital tools

• Take responsibility for your tasks and are motivated to gradually work more independently

• Have a proactive and service-minded approach when working with employees, managers and colleagues

• Are curious, eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions

• Communicate confidently in English. Knowledge of Danish would be an advantage, but is not required

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success, and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

We are expanding and looking for a new Manager to support our development projects!

**Join our team and let us make a difference together

**Our Process Development department in Hørsholm develops and optimizes vaccine production processes and supports our production sites. The Department handles diverse and evolving tasks and includes 32 members across 4 specialized teams.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. **Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

jobs.description:

The role will be responsible for performance management of the Revenue Planning Team, including LEAD counselor responsibilities and the integration of GDS resource capability.

As a key member of the Enablement & Technology domain, the role will collaborate on a broader set of Global Clients & Industries priorities and may act as sponsor for agreed strategic initiatives.

• 
Sales & Revenue Planning

Implement and maintain consistency of sales and revenue planning governance globally

• 
Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders to understand their priorities and translate them into coordinated revenue planning actions

Shape and sustain strategic stakeholder alignment across Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation, Industry, and Client Excellence, providing strategic leadership and influence to align cross-functional priorities to enable a consistent global revenue planning process

Manage Clients & Industries and other EY stakeholder relationships - Clients & Industries pillar leaders, Finance, Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation - and identify opportunities for effective collaboration

LEAD Reviewer responsibilities and provision of mentoring and regular feedback

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Associate Project Director, Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution? Do you have extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional projects in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry? If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Project Director, GRAPS.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and highly structured Associate Project Director to join our GRAPS Enablement & Insights function within Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety.

In this role, you will translate GRAPS priorities into integrated plans and disciplined execution across Global Regulatory Affairs, Global Patient Safety, and key enterprise functions. You will lead strategic and operational initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, vendors, and systems, while establishing clear governance, decision pathways, performance reporting, and risk management.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic perspective with hands-on project leadership in a global and highly regulated environment. You will work closely with the GRAPS Leadership Team, functional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen quality, compliance, predictability, and organizational scalability.

You will join the GRAPS team (Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety) and report directly to Jethro Ekuta, Chief Regulatory & Safety Officer, who is based in US.

• Lead assigned GRAPS projects and programs from initiation through closeout, establishing clear scope, objectives, governance, integrated plans, milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, budgets, risk controls, and measurable outcomes

• Partner with GRAPS leaders to translate strategic priorities into roadmaps and sequenced execution plans, while maintaining a consolidated view of the GRAPS project portfolio, including capacity constraints, interdependencies, risks, and decisions requiring leadership attention

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, programs, or major workstreams involving senior stakeholders, multiple functions, geographies, vendors, or systems

• Strong command of project and program management disciplines, including scope, schedule, governance, resources, budgets, dependencies, risks, issues, change control, and benefits realization

As a person, you are collaborative, inclusive, culturally aware, and effective in a global matrix organization. You demonstrate high integrity, discretion, ownership, and a strong commitment to transparent communication and follow-through.

Travel: 15-25 days a year.

jobs.occupation: Fulfilment Operations Team Leader – IKEA Odense (Fixed-Term Position)
jobs.description:
Who you are

We are looking for a dedicated, structured and development-oriented Fulfilment Operations Team Leader to join IKEA Odense. You are passionate about leadership, optimising logistics processes and achieving results through people.

This is a fixed-term position consisting of two exciting assignments. You will initially join our Outbound team, focusing on outgoing online orders, before transitioning to our Inbound team, where the focus will be on incoming goods flow. This will give you the opportunity to work with two key areas of our logistics operation and contribute to creating efficient workflows, high quality standards and great customer experiences.

In both roles, your most important task will be to deliver results through visible leadership, strong collaboration and the continuous development of both employees and processes.

To succeed in this role, it is important that you:

•Have 1–2 years of leadership experience, preferably with a focus on people and team management.

•Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

•Are well organised and able to maintain an overview in a busy and changing environment.

•Are motivated by developing people, creating engagement and achieving strong results through your team.

•Have an analytical and solution-oriented approach to operations, processes and optimisation.

•Ideally have experience in logistics – this is an advantage, but not a requirement.

•Ideally hold a forklift licence or are interested in obtaining one.

You must be comfortable working varying hours depending on your area of responsibility. In Outbound, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, while in Inbound, working hours will be 04:00–12:00.

A day in your life with us

During the first part of the position, from approximately January 2027 to May 2027, you will be the Team Leader of our Outbound operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that our online orders are handled efficiently and dispatched to our customers on time.

From May 2027, you will transition to our Inbound team, where you will cover a maternity leave position. Here, your focus will be on ensuring an efficient and well-functioning inbound goods flow, making sure that goods are handled correctly and on time and are available to the rest of our logistics operation.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•Leading, developing and motivating a team of approximately 20 employees.

•Ensuring efficient daily operations and a stable flow of outgoing online orders and incoming goods.

•Optimising outflow, workflows and processes, with a focus on productivity, quality and costs.

•Planning and coordinating resources to ensure that operational targets are achieved.

•Creating a culture focused on continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration.

•Monitoring relevant KPIs, customer satisfaction and operational performance.

•Ensuring employee well-being and actively working with sickness absence and employee retention.

•Ensuring that all work is carried out in accordance with IKEA's applicable safety rules and procedures.

Together as a Team

At IKEA Logistics, we play a central role in creating great customer experiences. Every day, we work to ensure that the right products are available, handled efficiently and moved further through the supply chain, always keeping the customer at the centre of everything we do.

We believe there is always room for improvement and that great results are achieved through engaged employees, clear leadership and strong collaboration.

As a Team Leader, you will play an important role in translating our goals into tangible results in everyday operations. You must be able to provide direction for your team, develop employees' skills and ensure that we continuously find new and better ways of working.

Questions and support? Let's connect!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Fulfilment Operations Manager Rune Nielsen at rune.nielsen@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Additional information

•This is a fixed-term position with 1st of January 2027 as expected start date until summer 2028.

•The position is based on an average of 37 hours per week.

•From January to May 2027, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, depending on operational requirements.

•From June 2027 until summer 2028, working hours will generally be 04:00–12:00.

•You must be willing to work additional hours and overtime when required by operational needs.

•Weekend work approximately every third weekend.

•You must also be willing to participate in the store's Duty/Floor management rotation at selected times.

•Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis
